# Deploy to VPS - Auto Deployment Workflow
# Runs automatically on push to main OR can be triggered manually

name: Deploy to VPS

on:
  # Auto deploy on push to main
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - '**.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/DEPLOY.md'

  # Manual trigger
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      deploy_message:
        description: 'Deployment message (optional)'
        required: false
        default: 'Manual deployment'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
